type.provenance: prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

date.provenance: This act shall take effect immediately.

who.provenance: no person shall sell or offer for sale in containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

action.provenance: prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

products.provenance: anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

value: No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes shall be held in violation of this section if they can show that they relied in good faith on the written assurance of the manufacturer of such product that such product met the requirements of this section.
